newsitem.title: UK: NatWest gains after positive Laing comment.
newsitem.headline: NatWest gains after positive Laing comment.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc rose on Friday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing repeated a "buy" recommendation and said there could be 25 percent upside in the stock, market sources said.
NatWest shares were up 5p at 690 by 0853 GMT in volume of 359,850 shares.

Sources said Laing had been a buyer of NatWest for some time but believed the stock was "grossly undervalued" since it was trading at a 40 percent discount to the rest of the UK bank sector and a discount to its historic valuation levels. Analyst at the brokerage said NatWest shares would be more fairly valued at between 850p and 900p to bring them into line with other UK banks, sources said.

NatWest shares lagged the rest of the UK market and the banking sector last year amid concerns about its strategy of expanding in investment banking and fund management through a series of major acquisitions.
